name: Mistral AI Provider
description: Registers Mistral AI as a provider plugin for the AI module, routing chat, embeddings and moderation operations through Mistral's API with the key stored in a Key entity.
project_description:
Want to have European AI working for you?

Mistral as an AI provider for the AI module makes it possible to generate text messages comme le tonnere.

 Use models like mistral-large-latest and mistral-embed, Codestal. 

 Features 
 Use Mistral together with all the AI module family.

 Post-Installation 
 
 Setup a key using the key module with your API key. 
 Visit /admin/config/ai/providers/mistral and connect the key you created. 
 Ready to start. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 The AI module .

 Supporting this Module 
 Support the AI module on OpenCollective .

 Community Documentation 
 The documentation is available on https://project.pages.drupalcode.org/ai/ 

 Back to top
